primaryChecks.text: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
primaryChecks.nextContext: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB本文にはNohahがなく、Geba住民の捕囚と父祖家の見出しが記される。別節・同名人物とも混同せず候補用例を除外。

excludedCandidates.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文にNohahの文字列も、当該町と結び付ける言及もない。出現候補を採用しない。
